we develop a robust learning algorithm that can learn the congestion functions, and use this learning to route users through the network.

The main takeaway from our work is that
we can design an efficient algorithm that learns to route users through a network while incurring a regret of $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{K})$, where $K$ is the number of routing requests received.
